requirements.statement: Rate limit: 50 message requests per second to the provider.
Retry transient errors using bounded retries only.
Never send duplicate notifications for the same result version (sends must be idempotent per result version, including across retries).
A notification may be sent only after the result has both completed clinical review and been released; if either condition is missing, no notification is sent.
Message content must be neutral, for example "An update is available in your secure portal."
Message content must contain no clinical content: no diagnosis, test name, result value, medication or treatment, and no other result detail.

unresolved.question: Which delivery channel should notifications use? Per policy, this is not to be inferred by engineering.
